historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent completed qualifying regular-season games before the historical cutoff.

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 8

model_version: V7.2.8 — user-directed P25 and Stage 2 ordering overrides
methodology_overrides: Replace the 7th-percentile statistic (P7) with the 20-game 25th percentile (P25).
Include P25 as an explicit reference in the Stage 1 ladder output (Step 2), alongside the fixed ladder hit rates.

For Stage 2 output ordering, group players by position, then order by proximity of the relevant alternate threshold to the current main-market line. Within each position, candidates whose percentile reference is above the market line appear first. Because P25 replaces P7, use P25 for this ordering.

percentile_statistics.P25: 20-game 25th percentile, standard linear interpolation, independent of L10; displayed in all four ladder tables.

stage2_ordering_instruction: Sort by position, then proximity to main-market line using P25 in place of P7. P25 above market line first; within each side sort by absolute distance.

source_snapshot.note: FanDuel main-market lines were present for every normalized player-market combination found in the DraftKings main-market data; no DraftKings fallback was needed.

eligibility_verification.rules: QB1; RB1/RB2; WR1–WR3; TE1. Out/IR omitted; questionable retained.
eligibility_verification.note: Drew Lock was excluded as Seattle QB2; the current depth chart lists Sam Darnold as QB1.

screening_summary.qualification_rule: Market HR >= 6/10 OR any fixed ladder >= 8/10.
